Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the action verb it modifies. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：装作祭拜，“装作” is used before a verb phrase to mean pretending to carry out that action. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩：他和他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩，Use a pronoun for Mengzi because he was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no competing male character has appeared. [rule: reference_form]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is a completed move at age five, so the last verb in the action phrase needs 了 to mark completion. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语“在墓地里”应放在动作“玩”之前。
“装”不能直接这样接“祭拜”，改为“装作祭拜”可以表达假装在祭拜。
孟子刚在上一句提到且没有其他男性人物，应使用“他”而不重复姓名。
五岁时搬家是已完成的事件，句末动词应使用“了”。
